_doc.zh: 基本情绪和复合情绪的原型动作单元组合，取自 Du、Tao、Martinez 2014（du2014）的表 1：prototypical 是超过 70% 的受试者都出现的 AU，variants 是只有部分受试者使用的 AU 及其比例。各 AU 的强度（0–5）是本项目的假设（见每条的说明）；强度随时间的变化没有定义。这是表情的计算模型，用于教学；模拟人并没有主观感受。
_doc.en: Prototype action-unit combinations of basic and compound emotions, from Table 1 of Du, Tao & Martinez 2014 (du2014): `prototypical` lists the AUs present in more than 70% of subjects and `variants` those used by only some, with the proportion. The intensity (0–5) of each AU is this project's assumption (see each entry); no time course is defined. This is a computational model of expression for teaching; the simulated body has no subjective experience.

note.zh: AU 组合和各变体 AU 的受试者比例取自 du2014 表 1（已打开核对）。强度（0–5）是本项目的假设：为了在本模型上读得出来而手调的；原文只给出用哪些 AU，没有强度。
note.en: The AU set and the proportion of subjects for each variant AU are Table 1 of du2014 (opened and checked). Intensities (0–5) are this project's assumption: hand-tuned so that the expression reads on this model; the paper states which AUs are used, not how strongly.
